leads.name: Holm Oak, Via Bobbio, Poggiardo
leads.reason: Register row 01/G751/LE/16 (MASAF and Puglia, girth 320 cm, height 20 m, urban) at 40.05159,18.38362, about 11 km from Otranto (bus, time not verified). Register only: no news, no iNaturalist observation within 100 m, no photograph, no pin evidence, and Via Bobbio is a street so no small named site. No photo or exact pin in reach; alive not checked beyond the register.

leads.name: Holm oaks and bay laurel, Villa Franite, Muro Leccese
leads.species: Holm Oak (Quercus ilex) x2 and Bay Laurel (Laurus nobilis)
leads.reason: Register rows 01, 02 and 03 /F816/LE/16 (girths 370, 330, 325 cm; 40.1052,18.3153 and neighbours, about 25 km from Otranto, over the 30-minute public-transport limit). Villa Franite is the Tenuta Le Franite / Villa Zaira holiday and wedding villa; no source says the grounds are open. Private: fails hard rule 10.

leads.name: Valonia Oak, Madonna del Carmine, Tricase (04/L419/LE/16)
leads.reason: Register row g340 h11 at 39.927553,18.378564, 40 m from the famous Quercia Vallonea (trc_001). The 02/L419/LE/16 row (g425 h22, 39.927881,18.378731) is trc_001 itself (same coordinate), so it is folded and not re-verified. This 04 row is a smaller neighbour within the same site with no source of its own and cannot be told apart from trc_001 or from other oaks there; iNaturalist 386313925 (2026-07-29, 5 m) is ambiguous between them. Not delivered to tricase-verified.json.

leads.name: Valonia Oaks, Bosco Falanite and Fanucchiare, Tricase (01/L419 and 03/L419)
leads.reason: Register rows g350 h20 (39.925047,18.379644) and g375 h20 (39.924836,18.379714), about 300 m south of trc_001. No web source for either, access to the wood not established (Bosco di Tricase is in a regional park but no source says these are walkable), no photograph. No tricase-verified.json delivery.

leads.name: Otranto town itself
leads.reason: Searched in Italian (alberi secolari, monumentali, ulivo millenario, Torre Pinta) and found no individually named tree in Otranto. Torre Pinta (Valle delle Memorie) is a private estate with a booked tour and its olives are not described as individual trees. Otranto has no naming body; the town page cannot reach four trees from this pass.
